title: Post Hoc Probes
summary: The F was significant; now which programmes differ? Tukey HSD, Bonferroni and Holm pairwise tests, and reading which pairs survive.
hints: `tukey <- TukeyHSD(fit)`; the table for programme is `tukey$programme`, with columns `diff`, `lwr`, `upr` and `p adj`.
`pairwise.t.test(pd$efficacy_t2, pd$programme, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")`, and the same with `"holm"`.
`rownames(tukey$programme)[tukey$programme[, "p adj"] < 0.05]` names the pairs Tukey says differ.
